dedupe_keys.name: puma cyclic quasi static test of a half scale modern unreinforced masonry building with plan irregularity

description: This dataset reports cyclic quasi-static tests on a half-scale modern unreinforced masonry building with an irregular plan, with measurements from the quasi-static loading, material characterisation tests and dynamic identification. It was published on Zenodo on 2 September 2025 by Abide Aşıkoğlu (Delft University of Technology) and Alberto Barontini, Graça Vasconcelos and Paulo Lourenço (University of Minho), and supplements an article in the Bulletin of Earthquake Engineering and a University of Minho repository item. Coverage is one building specimen tested in the laboratory. Access: a ZIP of about 160 MB and a README on Zenodo; data are in MATLAB and Excel formats. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free, with a request to cite the dataset and report discrepancies to the author. Caveats: a reduced-scale specimen; the test location is inferred from the University of Minho authorship, not stated in the metadata. Simulation uses: calibration of numerical models and fragility estimates for irregular masonry buildings. Related records: the EPFL-EUCENTRE shake table test and the ERIES masonry infill fragility data.
